verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a UI framework, and an ecosystem of official SDKs is a fair question for it. The evidence pack only describes the core framework, starter templates and a Babel preset. It documents no official SDKs (for example, API client libraries in multiple languages) for an AI-native user to build against, so this applicable axis gets none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
